threshold_rule: max validation recall s.t. validation FAR <= 0.12; tie-break lower FAR, then higher tau
test_failure_rule: TP <= 38 OR FP >= 69; verdict binary and final; near-miss (TP >= 37 AND FP <= 75) is descriptive only and remains FAIL
forbidden_actions: running the test export more than once
testing any checkpoint other than the frozen SHA256-verified checkpoint
any threshold sweep, re-selection, or adjustment on test scores
any epsilon other than 0.015 on the test split
testing a second candidate (ST1b6_lowFA, SA1_lowFA, or any other) if AFAC fails
test-score distribution exploration beyond the fixed confusion and class-source tables at the frozen tau
re-running validation selection after seeing test results
modifying this protocol, the markdown twin, or the gate CSV after the read
mandatory_disclosures: epsilon 0.015 was selected by a validation-only epsilon search; the claim is H15 at eps=0.015, not at the historical eps=0.030 evaluation point
Gate-5 argmax caveat: optionB clean 7-class accuracy 0.694 < 0.70
